import json,sys,re,pathlib
sc=pathlib.Path('SCORECARD.md').read_text()
actual=len(list(pathlib.Path('corpus/knowledge').glob('*.md')))
m=re.search(r'(\d+)/\d+ knowledge files mapped', sc)
claimed=int(m.group(1)) if m else None
json.dump({'observed': claimed==actual,'claimed':claimed,'actual':actual}, sys.stdout)

import json,sys,re,pathlib
actual={p.stem for p in pathlib.Path('corpus/knowledge').glob('*.md')}
text=pathlib.Path('corpus/README.md').read_text()
mentioned=set(re.findall(r'2026-\d\d-\d\d-[A-Za-z0-9\-_]+', text))
missing=sorted(s for s in actual if s not in mentioned)
dangling=sorted(s for s in mentioned if s not in actual)
json.dump({'observed': not missing and not dangling,'missing':missing,'dangling':dangling}, sys.stdout)

import json,sys,re,pathlib
text=pathlib.Path('SHONEN.md').read_text()
refs=sorted(set(re.findall(r'`([A-Za-z0-9_./\-]+\.(?:md|py|json|sh)):(\d+)', text)))
bad=[]
for path,line in refs:
    p=pathlib.Path(path)
    if not p.exists():
        bad.append(path+':missing'); continue
    n=len(p.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines())
    if int(line)>n: bad.append(path+':line>'+str(n))
json.dump({'observed': not bad,'bad':bad,'refs':len(refs)}, sys.stdout)

import json,sys,re,pathlib
text=pathlib.Path('SCORECARD.md').read_text()
paths=sorted(set(re.findall(r'corpus/knowledge/[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+\.md', text)))
missing=[p for p in paths if not pathlib.Path(p).exists()]
json.dump({'observed': not missing,'missing':missing,'count':len(paths)}, sys.stdout)
